description: Delete API Key - Revoke an API key. Revoking breaks any integration using it, so this needs the user's approval: the client asks the user directly, or the tool returns a preview and a login link where the user revokes it in the SalesBlink app.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.
